story_name: The Boy Who Stole a Star
story_overview: When twelve-year-old Soren accidentally catches a falling star in a jar, he discovers it is not a ball of fire but a living being — small, fierce, and desperately trying to return to the sky. Together they travel across a land of impossible geography, hunted by a Star Collector who traps stars to power his dark tower, to find the only mountain tall enough to launch her home.
